code.text: Physician-supervised structured diet and lifestyle modification program

note.text: 6-month physician-supervised structured diet and lifestyle modification program. Supervising provider: licensed registered dietitian operating under physician oversight. Patient attended 24 of 24 scheduled sessions (100% attendance). Dietary education completed. 8 lb weight loss achieved over program duration. Clinical summary on file. Program meets documentation requirements.

resource.conclusion: RECOMMENDATION: DEFERRAL. Patient does not currently meet psychological criteria for bariatric surgery. Findings: significant unresolved major depressive disorder (PHQ-9 score 18, indicating moderately severe depression) and active binge eating disorder (confirmed by structured clinical interview). Both conditions represent active psychiatric contraindications to bariatric surgery at this time. Recommend minimum 6 months of psychiatric treatment and stabilization prior to reconsideration. Clearance for bariatric surgery is NOT granted at this time.
